`habit done` now accepts an optional trailing date argument:

- `src/commands.js` — added `parseDay(word, now)`, recognizing `today`, `yesterday`, or `YYYY-MM-DD`; returns `undefined` for anything else.
- `src/cli.js` — the `done` command now checks whether the last CLI arg parses as a date; if so, it's stripped off and used as the completion day, otherwise it's treated as part of the (possibly multi-word) habit name, same as before.
- `README.md` — documented the new usage examples.

`node src/cli.js done read yesterday` and `node src/cli.js done read 2026-09-01` both work as requested, plain `habit done read` is unchanged, and all existing tests still pass.
